findings.highlight: Bushido is all about sympathy and no love
findings.evidenceJa: ブシドーは色無し恋無し情け有り
findings.governingReading: Bushido has no sensuality, no romance, but does have compassion.
findings.explanation: The English collapses the three-part rhythmic joke into two terms and loses the 色／恋／情け progression.

findings.highlight: you mustn’t anger Saber-chan too much
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーちゃんを怒らせちゃだめ
findings.governingReading: you must not make Saber angry
findings.explanation: Too much implies that provoking Saber to a lesser degree is permitted, weakening Taiga’s categorical prohibition.

findings.highlight: She can get scary if she gets really pissed off.
findings.governingReading: When Saber is angry, she is frightening in earnest.
findings.explanation: Pissed off introduces profanity and attaches intensity to Saber’s anger rather than to how frightening she becomes.
